description: Create a product in Billy, optionally with per-currency unit prices. Returns the created product including its ID.

accountId.description: Revenue account to code sales to (defaults to organization default)

description.description: Default description for invoice lines using this product

unitPrice.description: Unit price in the given currency

salesTaxRulesetId.description: Sales tax ruleset ID controlling VAT treatment

verbose.description: Return the full Billy response. Default false: compact records with key fields only (saves ~90% context)

name: create_product
